mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(cw.balance, 0) FROM users u LEFT JOIN coin_wallets cw ON cw.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO coin_wallets (user_id, balance) SELECT id, 0 FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE coin_wallets SET balance = balance + #{amount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
